newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: RFM, Urban to build condominium.
newsitem.headline: RFM, Urban to build condominium.

text.p: Food conglomerate RFM Corp and UrbanCorp Realty Developers Inc will build a 41-storey condominium in the emerging Bonifacio city, east of Manila, RFM said on Wednesday.

"We would take advantage of the continuing booming Philippine property sector even beyond the turn of the century as we contribute our share in the development of Fort Bonifacio," RFM chairman Jose Concepcion III said in a statement.
The two companies are part of the consortium which will develop the 214-hectare lot in Fort Bonifacio.
